requirement.value: The Soaring Strike spell (Core p. 189); no two PCs may both acquire it

system.description: Action + 10 MP: airborne — your melee attacks reach the unreachable, and other creatures cannot see you ( so cannot read your Tell; case-by-case, as ruled). At your turn's start you descend: Ballistic Extension costs no MP that turn, and with a spear it gains multi (2) and +10 damage. Printed: no two PCs may both hold it. The flight ruling of 7 Aug applies: going up where anyone can see you ticks the Miasma Clock by 1.
